hero.title: Interview Assistant
hero.subtitle: Practice out loud. Get structured feedback.
hero.tagline: Upload or record a self-introduction. AssemblyAI transcribes it, Gemini returns clarity notes, skills, character traits, and sentiment, and a chat coach API is ready for tips or speaking drills.
hero.impact: v2 split: Next.js UI for capture and review, FastAPI on Railway for transcription and Gemini scoring, with a hard 3-minute audio limit.

problems.d: Rehearsing an interview alone gives no read on clarity, tone, or what to change.
A free-form chat reply is hard to act on. The scorer returns a fixed shape: clarity, feedback, character, skills, and sentiment.
A self-intro is spoken. The model needs a transcript before it can judge the content.
The coach API must tell “give me tips” apart from “I’m ready to speak,” then return either coaching or a timed exercise.

layers.title: Next.js
layers.desc: Upload audio or record from the mic, preview the clip, enforce a 3-minute max, and show structured feedback.

layers.title: FastAPI on Railway
layers.desc: POST /self-intro for file analysis, POST /chat for coaching sessions, GET /health for key status.

layers.title: AssemblyAI
layers.desc: Transcribes the uploaded or recorded intro before Gemini reviews it.

layers.title: Gemini
layers.desc: Structured JSON feedback for intros, plus ready / not_ready coaching turns with short session memory.

highlights: Next.js UI with upload, microphone recording, and result panel
3-minute duration checks on upload, record, and analyze
POST /self-intro returns transcript plus structured feedback
POST /chat keeps in-memory session history for coaching
Gemini structured outputs replace brittle free-text JSON scraping
API deployed on Railway; UI intended for Vercel with NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
